observed_error: DLL load failed while importing QtCore: specified procedure could not be found
cause: PyInstaller resolved icuuc.dll from development-tool Poppler PATH; its ICU78 exports do not provide the unversioned Windows ICU API required by Qt6Core
evidence: Archive contains root icuuc.dll and icudt78.dll; Analysis-00.toc points at bundled Poppler. PE import/export comparison finds ucnv_open, ucnv_close and further required symbols missing. Windows System32 ICU provides these symbols.
repair: Build subprocess uses only Windows and interpreter paths; perform clean build and reject an archive containing foreign icuuc.dll. Add self-check failure JSON to prevent a hidden error dialog from blocking diagnostics.
preserved: No original data or existing Igor process was touched. Only this task's test executable processes were closed.
